findings.message: The `_mk_si` helper and several inline test fixtures construct JSON via `printf '...%s...' "$path"`, which produces malformed JSON if any path contains a double-quote, backslash, or newline; `jq -n --arg key "$val"` would be safe.

The disposition value read from `merge-result.json` (and analogously from `pr-result.json`) is passed through to `_pr_delivery_write_result` without validating against the ADR-054 allowed disposition vocabulary; a compromised delegate could inject an arbitrary string into the `disposition` field of pr-delivery's own v2 result.

`_PR_DELIVERY_ARTIFACTS_DIR` is initialised to the empty string at source time; if `_pr_delivery_on_signal` fires before `pr_stage_run` or `_pr_stage_run_inner` sets it to a real path, `_pr_delivery_write_result` silently returns 1 (the empty-dir guard) and no interrupted result file is written — the contract breach is not surfaced to the caller.
